立方セル・全電荷ゼロ・Coulomb定数1・導体境界（tin foil）。主例は非対称な8点電荷で、NaClの8イオン配置は別の解析照合用です。 採用した計算法 erfcで減衰する実空間和、Gaussian係数を持つ構造因子の逆格子和、−alpha/sqrt(pi) sum(q²)を加えます。力は各項の位置微分から求め、24成分を中心エネルギー差分と比較します。 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs. Assumptions, units and boundaries Cubic cell, zero total charge, Coulomb constant one and conducting/tin-foil boundary. An asymmetric eight-charge case is distinct from the eight-ion NaCl reference cell. Adopted numerical method Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences.
